messages:
priyanka: Putting the change window on hold. CI artifact upload failing intermittently, deploy-bot keeps retrying and blocking promote.

lee: Oof. Any logs?

priyanka: Relevant lines from bk-agent-21 at 06:10 UTC: 
```
[artifact-uploader] wrote 524288 bytes, then write returned: unexpected EOF
ERROR upload failed: unexpected EOF reading multipart body
stack: github.com/redwood/artifact/uploader.go:UploadChunk
```

carlos: Sounds like either network flakiness or the runner's ephemeral disk got evicted mid-upload. infra-bot, any runner events?

infra-bot: ALERT: eu-central-runner GC spike at 06:08 UTC, reclaimed 4 ephemeral volumes; average eviction rate x7.

natalie: If we wait and re-run, we probably miss the change window. We can pin to last healthy promoted artifact and manual-promote to keep the window.

lee: What's the last-known-good digest?

priyanka: Promoted from commit 1769700000, image sha256:9f2b7c8a1d2e. I can kick a manual promote if folks agree.

carlos: +1 from me. Also file an infra ticket for uploader resilience (retries/backoff) and consider lowering chunk size for now.

deploy-bot: MANUAL PROMOTE REQUIRED: run `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1769700000 --reason "CI uploader EOF; keep change window"` (requires approver or override).

natalie: I approve. Priyanka, please annotate release notes with the pin and follow-up.

priyanka: Running promote: `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1769700000 --author @priyanka`

ci-bot: PROMOTE: initiating canary rollout for release 2026.03.23-hotfix-pin (pinned to sha256:9f2b7c8a1d2e).

deploy-bot: PROMOTE OK: canary checks green (12/12) after 6m. Monitoring (15m).

priyanka: Release note draft: "Hotfix: pinned to previously promoted artifact (sha256:9f2b7c8a1d2e) due to intermittent multipart upload EOF in CI; infra follow-up opened (infra#4682)."

carlos: I've filed infra#4682: "multipart uploader EOF during runner GC spike; add chunk-retry and graceful abort handling." Assigning to @infra-team.

lee: Temporary mitigation: paused aggressive GC in eu-central for 20m. After the window we should restore GC settings and push a small uploader hardening change (chunk size + safer retry).

priyanka: Agreed. Keeping window open. If canary shows any signs of degradation I'll call rollback. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
